changeSet.author: demo
changeSet.createView: SELECT s.id AS studentid, s.name AS studentname, MAX(CASE WHEN m.subject = 'English' THEN m.score END) AS english, MAX(CASE WHEN m.subject = 'Kannada' THEN m.score END) AS kannada, MAX(CASE WHEN m.subject = 'Hindi' THEN m.score END) AS hindi, COALESCE(SUM(m.score), 0) AS total FROM students s LEFT JOIN marks m ON s.id = m.student_id GROUP BY s.id, s.name ORDER BY s.id
